legacyCompatibilityProfiles.purpose: Original ViewPropertyAnimator for View.animate() (RecyclerView DefaultItemAnimator, Material). Android 9 is used because Android 13 reads android.graphics.RenderNode, while the VM runs the Android 9 android.view.RenderNode. mRTBackend is never assigned in this source, so ViewPropertyAnimatorRT/RenderNodeAnimator are not needed at runtime.

resourceDataProvenance.idProfile: Android SDK API36 revision2 resource data (same profile loaded by runtime)
adaptations: All styleable memberships are copied from complete selected original AOSP13 declare-styleable elements.
AAPT2 independently verifies every public ID and numeric array/index ordering against the actual runtime ARSC profile.
Private attributes absent from SDK APIs use their real ^attr-private ARSC IDs and the same numeric ordering rule verified by AAPT2; no invented IDs or indices.
Internal R member names omit the external android namespace qualifier.
R.attr contains actual public/private framework attribute IDs from the resource profile.
Generated code contains only resource data; no Android Java algorithm is replaced.

Two complete original enum declarations copied byte-for-byte inside a compile-only outer Path shell.

Complete original AccessibilityDelegate declaration copied byte-for-byte inside a compile-only View shell.

Original measured-state constant declarations are copied verbatim. Only helper owner namespace changes.
View.sUseBrokenMakeMeasureSpec and sUseZeroUnspecifiedMeasureSpec remain explicit virtual-device compatibility fields, derived from the actual APK target SDK using the recorded original assignments.
View.class shell is excluded; no View constructor or measurement callback is fabricated.

copyOf overload provides compile-time metadata only; its method_info record is removed before D8. Sorting executes complete original TimSort/ComparableTimSort classes. Other Arrays APIs remain explicit core boundaries.

Original Resources/Theme interpolator XML loading and the complete original interpolator tag factory are also retained. Other animation loading methods remain unavailable. TestApi source-only annotations preceding methods are omitted, and the original implicit default constructor is retained.
Field initializer terminator semicolon retained outside its brace-delimited source slice. SystemClock.uptimeMillis remains an explicit VM monotonic-clock boundary.
Complete original BaseSavedState declaration, fields, constructors, writeToParcel and Creator implementation copied byte-for-byte inside an excluded View compilation shell.
Outer View.class is not a D8 input. AbsSavedState is the complete original source class.
Original private constructor and complete original locale-direction method copied byte-for-byte under their original TextUtils owner.

Original getChars/obtain/recycle helpers and their original sLock/sTemp fields are also retained. Original text direction, UTF16 offsets, span copying/filtering, text equality, index/range helpers, TruncateAt enum and EllipsizeCallback interface are also retained. Other methods remain explicit external boundaries.
ULocale.forLocale/isRightToLeft use the declared ICU/CLDR platform backend. DisplayProperties.debug_force_rtl is a virtual system-property boundary returning the original Optional type.
Complete original SavedState nested declarations including fields, constructors, creators and serialization copied byte-for-byte into excluded outer widget compilation shells.
TextView, CompoundButton and ProgressBar outer shell classes are never D8 inputs; this extraction does not claim original widget lifecycle methods or rendering.
Parcel and text/span serialization remain explicit runtime boundaries; no unsupported editor/span state is discarded.
Complete original metric nested classes copied byte-for-byte, retaining original fields, implicit constructors, toString/equals/hashCode.
Paint.class outer compilation shell is excluded. Paint native methods and convenience wrappers remain explicit host APIs; no SDK implementation bodies are packaged.

charsetLookupProvenance.scope: Six standard charset lookup/repertoire profiles; Java validation/cache/aliases execute original DEX. Codec native operations and external SPI loading are not implemented.
charsetLookupProvenance.nativeBoundary: NativeConverter exact boot-only JNI keys; no ELF execution; finalizers are opaque managed VM handles, not native pointers

androidJarUsage: API declarations for Android javac/D8 verification only; Java-core uses --release 8 JDK metadata. No SDK or JDK class implementation is packaged; only selected original source classfiles are D8 inputs
nativeBindingPolicy: Only exact boot-origin native keys registered by the runtime may execute. VM properties, arrays/opaque stable handles, and vector graphics use explicit VM/browser backends; handles are not native memory addresses. Unregistered native methods remain unsupported
